title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto: Which Architecture Actually Works for You — No Stripe Required
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.
imageAlt: Digital product delivery pipeline using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers for creators in Kenya
imageCaption: The automated delivery pipeline sends download links within 30 seconds of on-chain payment confirmation.

content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Platforms like Gumroad provide a convenient interface for selling digital products but come with significant transaction fees, often reaching 10% per sale. In contrast, a sovereign stack built with COREMERCH combines free tools like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-14|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] and NOWPayments to facilitate sales with a minimal 0.5% fee. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-17|difference]] translates into substantial savings for creators. While Gumroad offers ease of use, it restricts ownership and data access. A COREMERCH solution grants complete control, allowing creators to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-selling-digital-downloads-pakistan-until-you-read-3|Do Not]] a sustainable revenue stream without the overhead of platform fees.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Countries such as Nigeria, Venezuela, and Zimbabwe often face financial isolation, making traditional payment methods nearly impossible. Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip simply do not serve these regions, leaving creators without options. In contrast, COREMERCH's architecture is designed specifically for creators in these restricted countries. With NOWPayments supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies, creators can accept payments in their preferred digital currency, ensuring accessibility and financial sovereignty regardless of geographical limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When evaluating payment speed and fees, NOWPayments stands out. With a 0.5% fee structure, creators save significantly compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. For instance, on 100 sales of a $97 ebook, the fee difference amounts to $921 retained. Additionally, crypto payments processed via NOWPayments confirm quickly, often within minutes, allowing for instantaneous product delivery. This efficiency is crucial for maintaining a smooth user experience and maximizing revenue, something that traditional platforms struggle to offer.
With COREMERCH, you retain total ownership of your digital commerce stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical consideration for digital creators. With platforms like Gumroad, creators face ongoing dependencies and restrictions, while COREMERCH ensures complete ownership of the digital commerce stack. Automation features using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script enable efficient product delivery without manual intervention. This means once a sale is made, the product is delivered automatically, reducing effort and enhancing customer satisfaction. In a landscape where data is power, maintaining control over all aspects of the business is indispensable.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you are in a restricted region and want to maintain full control over your sales process, the COREMERCH solution is ideal. The Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack can be deployed quickly, enabling you to start selling with minimal setup. For those seeking comprehensive resources, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything needed to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack, empowering you for long-term success.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage a sovereign digital commerce stack like those offered by COREMERCH. By using free tools combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you can sell directly to customers without platform fees. This approach not only saves money but also grants you complete ownership of your sales process.
NOWPayments offers an unbeatable 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to sell digital downloads without platform fees, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all the blueprints and templates needed to establish your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, ensuring you can operate independently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
